hypotheses.claim: Recurrence continuation should condition on unresolved pressure and trend together with state/memory capacity and stability/overthinking indicators; pressure-trend alone is a candidate controller, not canonical semantics.
hypotheses.changed_from_prior: Adds memory/state-capacity and shallow-halt/overthinking alternatives to the prior dual-gate/stability-bound loop hypothesis.
hypotheses.falsifier: A simpler fixed-depth or pressure-only policy matches or beats outcome, cost, OOD robustness and safety across H1 episodes.
hypotheses.test: Ubuntu H1 matched-budget factorial over recurrence policy x memory/state capacity x GWT focus/reentry lesions.

hypotheses.claim: Effectful ClayCode compilation has three non-substitutable closure obligations: semantic preservation, current resource-lifetime identity, and effect-authority/provenance closure through the final gateway.
hypotheses.changed_from_prior: Unifies dual compiler trust with resource/authority evidence while preserving them as separate checks.
hypotheses.falsifier: A single checked layer provably subsumes the other obligations and passes adversarial wrong-lowering, stale-handle and ambient-bypass tests.
hypotheses.test: Production parser->IR->lowering->Ubuntu runtime mutation matrix with reference oracle, stale/reused handles, structural forgeries, revocation, FFI/subprocess escape.

hypotheses.claim: The Micro Visual Classifier should be modeled as a versioned open-set/prototype control plane with explicit UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT, bounded candidate promotion and rollback; trust tiers are policy variables, not sensor truth.
hypotheses.changed_from_prior: Separates demonstrated semantic-state expressibility from the still-open question whether continual online adaptation beats a frozen open-set prototype baseline.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen calibrated prototype/open-set baseline matches personalization utility and robustness with lower cost/risk.
hypotheses.test: Longitudinal Ubuntu H1 visual stream with OOD, poisoning, drift, forgetting and rollback; compare frozen vs bounded online MVC.

hypotheses.claim: Disjoint operations should be deterministic/noninterfering by default, while semantically conflicting asynchronous choices belong to execution/replay identity and must be recorded rather than hidden behind one nominal global schedule.
hypotheses.changed_from_prior: Makes choice receipts a semantic replay contract for conflicts, not merely a debugging trace feature.
hypotheses.falsifier: A serialized authoritative H1 has equal or better task/latency/fault coverage and makes all relevant choice receipts redundant.
hypotheses.test: Serialized vs recorded-choice concurrent H1 under matched workload plus outside-in failures.

hypotheses.claim: Causal lesion effects in adaptive FRANK are functions of intervention time, learner-state lineage and compensation trajectory; delayed recovery cannot be used to erase an acute causal dependency.
hypotheses.changed_from_prior: Adds adaptation/compensation as a first-class confound to emergence lesion/rescue logic.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen and adaptive learner arms yield equivalent causal effect estimates across immediate/delayed windows and rescue variants.
hypotheses.test: Paired frozen/adaptive lesions with immediate and delayed readouts, learner-state receipts, rollback rescue and shuffled/content-matched controls.

hypotheses.claim: H1/H2/H3 causal equivalence requires semantic interventions to translate through the representation map and preserve counterfactual effects; observational/state/output equivalence alone is insufficient.
hypotheses.changed_from_prior: Strengthens implementation-invariant loop-graph comparison with an explicit intervention-translation requirement.
hypotheses.falsifier: For a complete representation map, naive implementation-level interventions always equal translated semantic interventions across tested transformations.
hypotheses.test: Golden semantic interventions compiled to each Harness representation; verify commuting state/outcome/cause diagrams and include rotated/mixed-state negative controls.

hypotheses.claim: Evidence used for durable ClayGraph reversal/change should carry source-family ancestry so repeated descendants of one observation cannot count as independent evidence; diversity/lineage weighting should be tuned against adaptation delay.
hypotheses.changed_from_prior: Narrows RAB from a general reversal mechanism to a correlated-echo defense with an explicit plasticity cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: A simpler context-aware/source-correlation scalar equals RAB false-reversal protection and true-reversal speed on realistic traces.
hypotheses.test: Controlled source-correlation and reversal replay comparing context-only, lineage-weighted scalar and RAB across noise/delay/cost.
